items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: But I’m not in the same class as Don Costa or those guys who would just be on an airplane and take a paper and write a chart for Sinatra

ctx.x: But I’m not in the same class as Don Costa or those guys who would just be on an airplane and take a paper and write a chart for Sinatra that would be swinging like crazy without any score.
I can see the stewardess with you, “Would you like some coffee?” “Don’t interrupt me, I’m writing —”
